dedupe_keys.name: suen comparative performance assessment of turkiye s metropolitan water and sewerage administrations suki benchmarking

description: The Turkish Water Institute (SUEN) has run periodic comparative performance assessments of the water and sewerage administrations (SUKİ) of Türkiye's 30 metropolitan municipalities since 2015. SUEN produced the third round, published in June 2022: 29 administrations entered 2020 data for 192 variables through a web application, and the report analyses 173 performance indicators on institutional matters, finance, customer service, energy efficiency, drinking water infrastructure, quality and losses, wastewater infrastructure and treatment, and stormwater, with performance indices and total scores. Coverage is the metropolitan water utilities, which the report says serve more than 75% of the population. The 180-page report is a free PDF on the SUEN site, with all rights reserved to SUEN. Caveats: the utilities supplied their data on condition that it is not shared without their permission, so only the indicators and indices shown in the report are public, and response rates were 85% to 94% by variable group. Simulation uses: failure rates, water losses, energy use and service indicators of large utilities for capacity planning and resilience benchmarks. Related records: the DSİ water resources statistics (data-turkiye-dsi-official-water-resources-statistics) and the Czech utility benchmarking (data-czech-mze-water-utility-benchmarking-vak).
